description: Apply a structured change to FlowZap Code (insert/remove/update nodes or edges). Safer than regenerating entire diagrams - preserves existing structure. Returns an advisory quality block listing process defects (e.g. a step with no incoming edge, more than one start circle); the diagram is still created — fix the code and call again.

operations.description: Array of patch operations to apply

afterNodeId.description: Insert new node after this node ID

newNode.description: New node definition for insert operations
